title: Export project
description: Take this project with you. You get plain files that run with Docker alone.
includes: You get a docker-compose.yml, an .env.example with placeholders, a volumes list and a README.
gaps: Not carried over: the pinned host port, hooks, labels, probes, registry logins, and some resource limits. The README lists what applies to this project.

secrets.title: Include secret values
secrets.description: Adds a .env file with real secrets. Off by default.
secrets.warning: The archive will hold live secrets in plain text. Store it somewhere private and delete it when done. This action is recorded in the audit log.

stepUp: Exporting secret values of {{app}} needs a fresh confirmation.

cli.hint: Writes the same files to a folder.

errors.stepUpExhausted: Confirmation did not unlock the export. Try again.
